headline: Pickleball court placement at Slater Park sent to an off-cycle site visit before any recommendation is made.
summary: Members discussed Morley Field, the Thomas Duffy playground and courts, John St. Park, and parks programs. They planned an off-cycle visit to Slater Park to observe areas for pickleball courts. Three terms were renewed for Chairman Farrell, Vice Chairman Goodwin, and Commissioner Allen.
decisions: Set an off-cycle visit to observe areas of Slater Park before making a recommendation on pickleball courts.
Announced that three terms were renewed for Chairman Farrell, Vice Chairman Goodwin, and Commissioner Allen.

plain_text:
Pawtucket Parks Commission Meeting Minutes 
 
 
 
Start Time:    8/11/2026  7:05PM 
 
Roll Call:  In attendance – Commission members: Chairman Farrell, Imbracsio, Degre-Markley, 
Goodwin, Minton, Allen, Tierney, Nese 
 
 
 City Representative: Chris Crawley (DPW)  
 Luke McLaughlin (vacation)        
  
 Excused Absence Commissioner(s):  
 Not present: Healey 
 
   
Minutes approval –    
 
1st Motion by Commissioner:  Allen 
2nd Motion by Commissioner:   Goodwin in favor =     against =  0 
 
 
 
 
Public Input:  Per a correspondence received by the Pawtucket City Clerk’s Office on April 1, 2022, 
Mayor Grebien has requested that a Zoom meeting format continue in order for the public to view meetings.  
Committee members are required to be present at these meetings. 
 
• Sean was checking in on the skate park requesting an update 
• Luke McLaughlin was absent, Chris Crawley provided some input and agreed to follow up on 
the skatepark upkeep and future projects 
CHAIR UPDATE:  
• Chairman Farrell provided several updates via printed handouts 
o Updated contact list for commission members, including new Member Joe Nese 
o Morley Field update letter from the city 
▪ City moving underway with Phase I which includes environmental testing 
▪ Estimated time frame could be several months, but the process has started. 
o Police report on the Slater Park activity was handed out 
▪ General information on calls received, citations given etc.  This is in line with our quarterly 
update from the Police regarding the Park. 
 
 
REVIEW OLD BUSINESS  
 
o John St. Park update 
o Opening September – structure in place 
 
 
NEW BUSINESS 
 
• Introduction of newest commission member, Joe Nese
• Announcement of 3 terms renewed for Chairman Farrell, Vice Chairman Goodwin and Commissioner 
Allen 
• Discussion of Thomas Duffy playground and courts 
o Tennis courts, playground, and pickleball courts 
• Discussion and handouts regarding placement of pickleball courts in Slater Park 
o Commission to meet off-cycle to observe areas of the park and make a recommendation 
 
PARKS AND REC UPDATE 
• Summer camps have been a great success 
• City pools closing 3rd week in August 
• Pawtucket Arts Festival to occur the weekend of 8/30 
• Fall sports are starting to gear up, football etc. 
• Haunted tunnel is already in the works 
• Soccer starting at Max Reed Field 
 
 
There was no formal tree update, however Chris Crawley stated that DPW has been planting and maintaining 
them throughout the summer, with more planting to come. 
 
  
 
OPEN FORUM  
•  
 
 
 
Motion to adjourn: 
1st Motion by Commissioner Goodwin 
2nd Motion by Commissioner Imbracsio 
 
 
End time:     8:12 pm
